data.body: **[P2] Evict by record age, not ARN fairness order.** `_pending` is ordered by round-robin ARN position, and scheduling an existing ARN moves it to the end while older records remain at the front of its deque. Thus `next(iter(self._pending))` may select a newer record: with cap 2, scheduling `A1`, `B1`, then `A2` evicts `B1` while retaining older `A1`, potentially dropping another execution's terminal snapshot. Track global insertion sequence separately from ARN fairness and evict the true oldest record; add an interleaved-ARN cap test.
